message: No detected input validation: The code checks whether the path is a file or directory and catches load exceptions, but performs no schema, dtype, or value-range validation on the actual data loaded from the HDF5 files.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths only; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on the local files.

No detected label flipping detection: The code loads labels from the HDF5 file and uses them directly without any distribution comparison, validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tooling.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset preparation only loads and concatenates HDF5 data with optional normalization; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code accepts a model load path via '-l'/'--load' option but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed before loading the model.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads datasets and splits them but performs no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline code shown.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test dataset is loaded, there is no evidence of cryptographic signing/hashing of evaluation data, and the test split isolation from training is not clearly enforced; no multiple independent metrics or tamper-evidence mechanisms are visible.

No detected input sanitization: The dataset loading code reads HDF5 files directly into DataFrames without any shape, range, or schema validation on the input features before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The forward pass returns softmax outputs directly with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on the model's predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a numeric jet classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
